history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: CSV row 2461 ('Bakreshwar Temple (Vakranath Shiva Temple)', Bakreshwar, West Bengal) is a confirmed duplicate of seq 1193 / id bakreshwar-temple-birbhum, which already documents the whole Bakreshwar Shakti Peetha complex including both the Mahishmardini and the Vakranath/Vakranath shrines. Vakranath (also rendered Bakranath, 'bent god' - linked to sage Ashtavakra's penance) is the Shiva lingam that is the Bhairava guardian of this Shakti Peetha, where the centre of Sati's eyebrows is believed to have fallen. The town itself is named for this deity. No independent separate 'Vakranath Shiva Temple' distinct from the Shakti Peetha complex was found in the consulted sources. A separate file is written per the schema; consider MERGING or dropping in favour of seq 1193. Coordinates identical to seq 1193 (same complex).

name: Bakreshwar Temple (Vakranath Shiva Temple)
town_description: Bakreshwar is a pilgrim village on the southern bank of the Bakreshwar (Paphara) stream in Birbhum district, ~7 miles north-west of Dubrajpur and ~18 km south-west of Suri — called the 'village of deities' for its many temples, also noted for its thermal springs and the nearby Bakreshwar Thermal Power Station township.

travel.airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Kolkata (~230 km); Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport Durgapur ~51 km (verify)
travel.railway: Dubrajpur (~7 miles / ~11.7 km); Sainthia Junction also cited
travel.road: Metalled road Suri-Dubrajpur via Bakreshwar; direct buses from Suri, Dubrajpur, Bolpur, Sainthia and Durgapur
